استعفين (form X)
# اِسْتَعْفَيْنَ (istaʕfayna) /is.taʕ.faj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
# اُسْتُعْفِينَ (ustuʕfīna) /us.tuʕ.fiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
# اِسْتَعْفِينَ (istaʕfīna) /is.taʕ.fiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
